Policy: Failure-boundary inventory only. No runtime success tracking or health polling. A silent log does not prove gameplay acceptance.

Mods.Trigger: Native initialization and existing functional operations
Mods.Postcondition: Existing install/save invariants retained; fear overflow preserves original SE contribution
Mods.Gap: Fear results, rendered HUD, native effects and multiplayer require manual acceptance; no runtime success monitor.

Mods.Trigger: Existing host initialization and dependency/package audit
Mods.Gap: No added mission audit; plugin presence does not prove gameplay.

Mods.Trigger: Named initialization, persistent initialization, application and mission boundaries
Mods.Postcondition: Existing guarded actions and error boundaries; no added native diagnostic reads.
Mods.Gap: Initialization/application is not a native outcome proof. Individual fixes require their triggering scenarios.
Mods.Failure: Named per-feature failures and existing callback errors

Mods.Trigger: Startup stages, mission callbacks and cost/tooltip errors
Mods.Postcondition: Startup stages returned; existing failure boundaries active
Mods.Gap: Final resource charges and rendered tooltips are not automatically proven.

Mods.Trigger: Startup, limit feature initialization and mission callbacks
Mods.Postcondition: Feature initialization returned; existing limit failures reported
Mods.Gap: Exercise actual building placement and player limits.

Mods.Trigger: Startup, cost application and mission callbacks
Mods.Postcondition: Named cost actions returned; override failures reported
Mods.Gap: Native recruitment charges and composition with other price writers require real actions.

Mods.Trigger: Startup, capacity initialization and external state-change notification
Mods.Postcondition: Initialization returned; failed notification subscribers isolated and reported
Mods.Gap: Recruitment/reservation effects need corresponding game actions.

Mods.Trigger: Mission, save/restart, required Lord package selection
Mods.Postcondition: Existing round-trip/save checks retained; unreadable required package metadata reported
Mods.Gap: Creator permissions, Lord content and restart provenance need exercised load paths.
Mods.Failure: Existing settings/package errors plus required-lord-package-fingerprint and lord-package-manifest

Mods.Postcondition: Existing feature isolation retained; errors remain unconditional
Mods.Gap: Actual native/visual results of each enabled option are not inferred from activation.
Mods.Failure: Existing functional errors/warnings use structured per-session reporting

Mods.Trigger: Mission lifecycle and actual random-event execution
Mods.Postcondition: Existing event result and exception guards retained
Mods.Gap: An event not drawn/executed is unexercised, not failed or verified.

Mods.Postcondition: Existing operation failures reported; policy and lifecycle recorded
Mods.Gap: Blueprint appearance and completed castle placement need real operations.

Mods.Trigger: Startup stages and mission start callbacks
Mods.Postcondition: Stage completion observed; existing spawn/initialization failures retained
Mods.Gap: Final starting resources/troops require relevant start modes.

Mods.Trigger: Independent registration, settings application and mission release
Mods.Postcondition: Pushed SE overrides read back; owned layer removal checked; optional fear failure isolated
Mods.Gap: Simulation and visible text evidence are provided independently by APIShared; rendered pixels remain manual.
